Definition: to slaver (with spittle), i.e. (by analogy) to emit a fluid (ulcerous or natural)
BiblicalUsage: Rûwr carries the sense of to slaver (with spittle), that is (by analogy) to emit a fluid (ulcerous or natural). It stands in Leviticus 15:3: "…uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put rûwr here on purpose, and I take his word for it.
